config_name: OMEN 17 — RTX 5060 8GB, Ryzen AI 9 365, 32GB DDR5, 1TB SSD, 17.3" FHD 144Hz

battery.notes: ~83Wh. OMEN 16/17 chassis with Ryzen AI 9: ~4-5h light use per user reports; RAM tier does not change runtime.

price.notes: BBY sku 19763449 (marketplace seller PC Heaven): regular $3,929 anchor, sale $2,749 (verified 2026-11-24 via BBY search API). PC Heaven regular-price anchors inflated ~40% — treat $2,749 as the real street price. A Win 11 Pro twin exists at $2,799 (sku 19763441).

offers.name: HP OMEN 17 17.3" 144Hz Gaming Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - RTX 5060 8GB - Windows 11 - Black

praises: 32GB from the factory at $2,749 sale: the RAM HP charges a premium for elsewhere, pre-installed
RTX 5060 + Ryzen AI 9 365 handles 1080p-ultra/1440p-medium gaming with DLSS 4 comfortably
17.3-inch 144Hz panel at this price: big screen without flagship money
Socketed DDR5 and standard M.2 — already at 32GB but still user-serviceable
Numpad keyboard and full port set (HDMI 2.1, USB-C with DP, Ethernet) for desk use
complaints: Battery ~4-5h light use — mediocre for a Ryzen AI chip
Base 144Hz IPS is dim (~300 nits) with washed-out viewing angles
Plastic deck flexes near the vents; not the sturdiest 17-inch
Average 720p webcam and mics — poor on calls
$350 RAM upcharge over the 16GB SKU is steep vs buying SODIMMs; HP bloat (OMEN Hub, McAfee) out of the box

design_philosophy: HP's big-screen mainstream gaming value play: the OMEN 17 stretches the 2025 OMEN 16 chassis to 17.3 inches at the same price points, prioritising screen size and GPU-per-dollar over thinness, battery, or premium materials. This 32GB RTX 5060 config is the multitasker's pick of the line.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the 16GB sibling baseline (61.json) per SHARED-omen-17.md: 32GB RAM → productivity +0.5 and ai_ml +0.5 (more headroom for local models / heavy multitasking); all else identical.
